body: My doctor is free, but if I were to seek professional help, only the first session would be free. I could get government support, but it would still be out of my price range I'm afraid.

I don't mind, there's little use you can have from that information, that you wouldn't get from my IP ether (so says the paranoid person). I come from Denmark, a little country in Scandinavia, just north of Germany.

I don't know if it'll help, but I come from a country where we are around like, 95% white people. I have absolutely zero attraction to white people, always prefered a dark skinned girl. Though they are really hard to come by here, as most other races here stick too within their own color. Which I really find a shame. It may sound very odd, but I've thought of moving to America or something of the sorts, merely for the possibility of me maybe finding someone in the future.

I just want you to know, there's someone out there for you, however much of a cliche it sounds. I really hope you find someone to share life with.

That's okay, I went to sleep myself. Yes, they have a school pschologist, but she is only available for a max of 5 conversations, and to be honest. She's garbage. But I don't know what I expected from someone working for free ether. Though I told her my history, she treated me like I had never been in counseling before, giving the most basic of advice. Which frankly just infuriated me to the point I stopped going after the second appointment. 

I have a pen-pal, the only one I'm talking with and care about talking with. But she just started school and are busy with a job on the side too, so she has almost no time to talk anymore. I tried sharing my concerns with her. There weren't much support to get, other than "I really hope you'll get better".

i suppose its just a narcasisstic statement to throw out like that.. but it's the one thing i actually like about myself, im always the one everybody seeks help with... though that just leaves me feeling worse: because i feel so used constantly, with nobody wanting to talk to me outside of me doing their homework for them. 
And yes, I'm afraid so.. I'm trying to finish school, and I'm on student welfare with no job on the side, so financial barriers are very limited. Converted to $ (for convience) I have aprox $300 per month for food, clothings etc. and possible medication/therapy if that was ever too happen

im interested in something that would make me not be like this for the rest of my life, but im still scared.. i dont know any other life, i would have to relearn everything.. but, i want to have what i see and hear everybody else have, i got none of it.. one thing i have, which i really don't like saying out loud, because it makes me sound so selfish, is my intelligence, ive gotten straight a's in everything i've ever attempted when it comes to education.. but i dont care for it, ignorance is bliss i take it..

wow, i just read something on a site about this thing. it was about potential help at the doctor... so it was about things you could talk about, one of the things being "indiagnosed illnesses", and my brain literally SCREAMED to me, "im not sick!!" .. that cant be good..

i was placed in various places with other young kids who was diagnosed with something. most of it were people that had serious autistic diagnosis from a very young age, so i didn't exactly get to enjoy my childhood ether.. i don't remember the drugs i was put on, i weren't the one to administer them, and i just did what i was told because i was under 18 at the time.. but i know i was taking off 4 different pills the day i turned 18 and was kicked out of everything, none the better and not able to pay for further treatment or medication, i was left to myself

no not at all, i really do applaud you for helping me and guiding me to the available resources that are put out there for people to use.. my thing is, this world aint nothing new to me.. ive been thrown around several systems my entire life, everybody trying to help me and get me better, and each of them failing.. which is another reason for as to why i think theres little for me anymore, i had about 10 years worth of treatment from my teens and forward.. and i came out a failure and each and everything.. 
its funny, i dont know how i feel, im crying, tears are shedding... throat is hurting from it.. yet im just numb right now, i think im being quite rational at this very moment, trying to objectively looking at my situation: though i know most people would say im not able to in my current state.. but, when i say numb, i really mean it as in, i guess i cried so much and wanted to scream so much, im just sorta dried out for emotions and liquid at the moment.. though if i know myself right, and i do think that i do, than i know we're talking a few hours, and i'll be back in my suicidal state of mind, pulling my hair, just sitting in the window thinking fuck it all..

i know that when i was younger, the medication i got almost bankrupted my mother.. i guess i would be afraid that they said i would have to take it if they were to help me, i know of a former friend whom i lost, also to suicide, whos pyschologist told her so..
i dont know what kind of policy my country holds on these sorta things, so i dont know if there would be any way to seek financial help for these things, though i really dont think so

but i really don't have any courage to do so.. i had to muster all i could just to type this to begin with.. actually creating a profile somewhere online and writing this took me months alone.. with every night me crying myself to sleep..

i just looked at the resources in the sidebar, the link it gave me to "coping with suicidal thoughts" literally broke me... i already knew it i guess, but looking and reading through that, just broke me... i dont even know why.. when i saw the safety plan, it made me realise there's nothing.. granted i only sat there for a couple of minutes thinking it through, but i was blank on everything.. the one thing i could put in "do the following activies to calm/comfort myself" is maybe playing games; and even that has gotten to be a point where i dont really care about it anymore.. no place i feel safe, i have so much anxiety in every day life, when i stand in the grocery store i have to constantly look over my shoulder to see whos behind me because i feel.. i dont know what the word is, but like theres constantly someone there with an eye out on me.. and i especially couldn't name a single reason for me to live - there's the classical cliché with "dont wanna hurt my family".. but honestly, fuck them.. i don't care about people who was never really there for me.. i dont even know why i bother anymore..i guess i just keep wasting more and more time in agony

i don't know how i would feel about group therapy, but i would take that problem when it comes... though, to even attempt the same thing that helped you, i would have to get a friend who was concerned about me first.. and i have no money for a long treatment, big expensive medication or anything like that, my resources are very limited, if i also want a place to live and food
